thread:
alice: Heads-up — noticed a mismatch between the SDK v2 retry header and our err-ref examples. Getting 429s in the E2E samples when context is > 12k. Can docs team own a quick migration snippet?

chad: Ugh. Is this the header rename to X-Retry-Window? I remember a change in the client last month.

maya: Yep. SDK v2 uses `X-Retry-Window` + slightly different default backoff. Our docs still show `Retry-After` examples.

alice: Exactly. For troubleshooting guide we should: 1) show the header mapping, 2) add a tiny snippet for context trimming, 3) add a short note about 429s when using long streaming sessions.

jamal: I can add the code snippet for context trimming in Python. Example (pseudo):

```
# trim last message to fit window
if len(tokenize(history)) > MODEL_MAX_TOKENS - 256:
    history = history[-6:]
```

chad: Can you also include the backoff suggestion? Something like exponential with jitter plus a max attempts note.

jamal: yeah, will add: `attempts = 0; backoff = min(2**attempts + jitter(), 30)` and show 429 handling.

maya: I'll PR the err-ref page with the header mapping and a small blurb that links to the SDK snippet. Also will fix two dead links I found in the retries section.

alice: Nice. Docs-bot — can you create a checklist comment on the new PR that includes: link fixes, snippet, example output, and QA steps? :slightly_smiling_face:

docs-bot: @alice created checklist at https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/1428 with items: [link-fixes, add-snippet, add-output, run-local-smoke].

chad: Quick question — should the sample highlight Dedicated behavior (burst capacity) vs Hosted? People confuse rate-limits with hosted throttles.

maya: Good call. I'll add an aside: "Dedicated customers: contact support for burst policy; Hosted: standard 429s apply."

alice: Also include a tiny fallback recipe: if you hit repeated 429s, auto-fallback to a lower-capacity model variant, e.g., `rwd-medium` before giving up. Keep it a short code example.

jamal: Draft snippet for Node:

```
// fallback example
try {
  resp = await client.generate(req)
} catch (e) {
  if (e.status == 429) {
    req.model = 'rwd-medium'
    resp = await client.generate(req)
  }
}
```

chad: Can we also add a small test vector for the docs' CI: a synthetic request that triggers our context-trim path (deterministic)?

maya: Yep I can add a smoke test under /docs/tests/ that posts a long prompt and expects the trimmed prompt to be used. Will include an assertion for the trimmed token count.

alice: Ownership: maya — PR for err-ref + links + tests. jamal — add Python/Node snippets + backoff examples. chad — review and add Dedicated note. taylor — do you mind doing a quick accessibility pass on the code blocks?

taylor: On it, will check code block language labels and alt text for images.

maya: PR started: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/1428 — pushed initial edits and left TODOs for snippets.

chad: Ping me when snippets land and I'll do the final review. Also let's add one more line: "If you continue to see 429s despite trimming & backoff, open a support ticket with request_id and payload size."

alice: Perfect. One last note: update the runbook link; I fixed the canonical URL in the draft to /runbooks/ratelimit (old link was /runbook/rate-limit). That's one of the link fixes.
